name: step-up-dumbbell-biceps-curl-single-leg-balance
title: Step-Up: Dumbbell (Biceps Curl, Single Leg Balance)
primer: This exercise combines a step up with a biceps curl.
steps: Place a box or bench in front of you.
Place a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing up.
Keep your back straight, your shoulders back and your abs drawn in.
With one leg, step up on to the box and raise your other leg up (as if taking another step).
At the top of the step, curl your arms up by bringing your forearms towards your shoulders.
Return to the starting position and switch legs.
